code:
Month 0   Audit scores the rollout well; SFTP export formally excluded
Month 4   API migration slips to month 8 -- an unrelated project delay
Month 9   Credential-stuffing hit reaches svc-claimflow-sftp (reused
          password, no MFA -- it was a non-interactive scheduled job)
Month 9   Full shared-folder export pulled -- far more than claims data
caption: The account was never attacked because the zero trust program failed -- it was never inside the program at all.

steps.label: Track exclusions as risk items
